entities.name: Fujiwara no Okikaze
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fujiwara no Okikaze  was an early 10th Century middle Heian waka poet and Japanese nobleman. He was a great-grandchild of Fujiwara no Hamanari. He is designated as a member of the Thirty-six Poetry Immortals. 38 of his poems are included in the anthologies compiled by the imperial order following Kokin Wakashū. One of his poems is included in the famous anthology Hyakunin Isshu.
